summary.headline: Addenda et Corrigenda
summary.text: Addenda and corrigenda to pages 4–161, correcting Greek readings, folio references, translations, and notes on Orpheus, astrology, alchemy, geography, omens, and planetary doctrine. Authorities cited include Abel, Wünsch, Berthelot, Ruelle, Maximus Planudes, Beckh, Plato, Apomasar, and Lydus.
